(12/?/2023) "Garden Of Eden" is scrapped.

d4vd's debut studio album "WITHERED" was released through Darkroom/Interscope records on April 25th, 2025 after a year in the making. He kicked off this rollout in early 2024, with 2 singles "Leave Her" and "2016". He then dropped 2 more songs "My House Is Not A Home" and "There Goes My Baby". After a year hiatus of releasing music. d4vd announced "WITHERED" in early February 2025. The official rollout started with the track "One More Dance" being the lead single. Other songs "Crashing" and "What Are You Waiting For" were released shortly after. A month after release, bonus tracks "Where Did You Go?" and "Unrequited" were added to the tracklist.
